description:
The best all-in-one screen recorder and video editor. Record your screen, add video effects, transitions and more.

Camtasia is a video-based screen capture program that enables users to demonstrate and communicate ideas or share knowledge using video. From quick video demos to extensive video projects, Camtasia has a wide range of editing tools to create video content from a variety of sources. Users can record from webcam or screen, introduce a variety of effects, and easily share videos over multiple channels.
New Features
- Added basic SVG support to Camtasia Editor.
Bug Fixes
- Protect against a crash on exit if a stray resize event arrives after shutdown begins.
- Fixed a bug where decoded 10-bit HEVC video could have washed out colors.
- Fixed an issue where color properties on lottie files did not show in the properties panel.
- Fix opening Camtasia Online projects with multi-byte characters in name.
- Fixed an issue where some textbox scrollbars had the wrong style.
- Fixed potential crash on cancellation of a local file export.
- Fixed a bug where video in exported MP4 files could have inaccurate colors.
- Prevent launching Audiate when deployed off.
